title: India's First General Election, 1951–52

endcard.line: Pictures: Photo Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (public domain), two photos

segments.say: Between October nineteen fifty-one and February nineteen fifty-two, India held its first general election. Seventeen point three crore people were on the rolls.
Voters chose four hundred and eighty-nine members of the first Lok Sabha. Because of harsh weather and hard terrain, voting ran in sixty-eight phases.
In Delhi, in January nineteen fifty-two, a polling officer marks a voter's finger with ink before she votes.

anim.title: How you voted
items: A separate ballot box for each candidate
Each box marked with a name and symbol
Drop your ballot in your choice

segments.say: Each candidate had a separate ballot box, marked with the candidate's name and symbol. You voted by dropping your ballot paper into the box of your choice.

items.text: first Chief Election Commissioner, Sukumar Sen

segments.say: The Election Commission was set up on the twenty-fifth of January nineteen fifty. Its first Chief Election Commissioner, Sukumar Sen, took charge in March nineteen fifty.
By twenty fourteen, the electorate had grown more than four point seven times.
For GS One, remember the first election's scale: seventeen crore electors, four hundred and eighty-nine seats, sixty-eight phases.

sources: PIB, Comparison of the Indian Electorate from 1951–1952 to 2014, 23 February 2014 (relid 104164): total electorate grew from 173,212,343 electors in the 1st General Elections of 1951–52 to 814,591,184 in 2014, more than 4.7 times

Wikipedia, '1951–52 Indian general election' (read): held between 25 October 1951 and 21 February 1952; 489 members of the first Lok Sabha; 401 constituencies in 25 states; Election Commission created in 1949, Sukumar Sen appointed first CEC in March 1950; each candidate allotted a different ballot box with name and symbol; held in 68 phases due to harsh climate and challenging logistics
Election Commission of India, 'About ECI': the Commission was established on 25 January 1950

reviewNote: The electorate figure is from PIB (an ECI release); seats, phases, dates and the ballot-box method are from Wikipedia. ECI's own narrative report on the first election didn't load here; check these against it before approval. Turnout is left out: the PIB turnout table for 1951–52 didn't read cleanly, and candidate counts differ between sources. Both photos are 1952 government (Photo Division) photos; no party symbol is shown in the chosen pictures. Moving facts: none. The Commission's start was corrected from 1949 to 25 January 1950 (ECI).
